scope: Outcome-free source feasibility across all112 candidate CIKs in the fixed original-candidate ledger; not a historical stock universe or accepted training dataset.
selection: For each candidate CIK and filing-year stratum select the earliest archive_filed then accession original10-K. No amendments, replacement after failure, price outcomes or source-presence selection. Preserve empty strata as absent.
http_policy: Record404 as missing and continue. Stop the entire collection on403,429,other transport/status errors or corrupt cache. Never switch identity or endpoint.
arithmetic_policy: Fixed filing_flow_feature_rules.json, original DEI report end, exact original instance checksum. Record unsupported parsing or unready arithmetic; no concept broadening or replacement samples.
feasibility_gate: At least80% of selected original documents must yield ready flow arithmetic overall and at least70% in every stratum; failures/missing documents count in denominators. Empty issuer strata reported separately. Passing authorizes only further source/causal coverage review, never model training or selecting stocks.
publication_and_identity: Extracted instances may be derived later. Original publication/vintage and issuer-to-share links remain unverified and block dataset acceptance.
